summary: Build ISO/IEC 17025 LMS knowledge, review the PECB Foundation exam, and prepare for a laboratory-management credential.
audienceIntro: ISO/IEC 17025 Foundation is suited to people who contribute to testing and calibration laboratory management or want a grounding in Laboratory Management Systems. It is an entry-level course for laboratory professionals and prospective laboratory-management practitioners.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course.
